card.name: Verbs after a web page subject
card.fires_on: A verb or linking word right after a subject noun phrase in general web text, such as allowing, shall, can, are, or been. It also fires on a few other words that continue a clause.

modes.label: Small word in a list or clause
modes.description: A short word such as and or the continues a list or sentence.
